body: The model extracts frozen DINOv2 patch tokens, fits a PCA normal subspace from only normal support tiles, and scores residual distance for every patch.
The run is local and reproducible; SubspaceAD is inspiration, not an upstream execution claim.
research.tagline: Eight normal SEM support tiles define the normal subspace.
research.title: Frozen DINOv2 + PCA residual baseline

body: The partial archive yielded 1,501 readable SEM JPEGs: 1,385 normal and 116 anomaly images. One truncated normal file was excluded.
Image labels support AUROC/AUPR. Pixel metrics are intentionally withheld because aligned masks were not recovered.
research.tagline: SEM proxy evidence is strong enough for a pilot ask, but masks and SiC labels remain the gating data.
research.title: Recovered MIIC partial evidence
